changes: Bounded caller-driven batch with per-store-object single-flight shared across pump instances
Cancellation, timeout and redacted errors; timeout schedules existing durable retry state
Uncooperative transport retains lock until settlement; late receipt ignored
Same idempotency key reused on later attempt; remote dedupe is required from authorized transport
Stale edits cannot be cleared by earlier sends
limitations: No actual endpoint/authentication or private writes
No automatic background scheduler or live scene wiring
Single-flight is per store object, not across tabs or independently opened DB connections
A transport that never settles keeps that store object locked; caller must provide cooperative abort and remote idempotency
ObjectCraft local blank cards/books are a separate contract and not synchronized by this pump
